objective: Prove the smallest fail-open conditional Router control flow offline without changing the frozen fixed-high service.
allowed: scope, decision, execution, risk, deviation, ledger, manifest, and acceptance records
forbidden: live call or real provider instantiation
automatic clarity model or default Router gate
Router retry, repair, second question, or second Router call
modification of deterministic engine, calendar, specs, fixed-high prompt, validator, P8/P9 mapping, or historical evidence
HTTP, UI, database, queue, product wiring, P9 art, deployment, production, or default replacement
routing_order: one typed critical ambiguity -> at most one LIGHT_ROUTER
any Router failure -> DIRECT_HIGH with original question
ASK_ONCE -> one user answer or skip -> DIRECT_HIGH with original question
